variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Quantum machine learning (QML) studies whether quantum information processing can improve a machine learning task. A quantum circuit may encode an input, transform a quantum state, and produce measurements that a classical program turns into a prediction, loss, kernel value, or optimization update.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Define success with matched boundaries”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Learn from classical data
pairs.detail: Quantum kernels and variational classifiers can process encoded vectors.
pairs.explanation: Quantum kernels and variational classifiers can process encoded vectors. The experiment must show that encoding and measurement do not erase the proposed gain.

pairs.label: Learn from quantum data
pairs.detail: A circuit can classify or characterize states produced by a quantum process.
pairs.explanation: A circuit can classify or characterize states produced by a quantum process. Avoiding complete classical tomography may be the central research opportunity.

pairs.label: Optimize a classical objective
pairs.detail: QAOA or annealing proposes candidates while classical code constructs the objective, tunes parameters, and validates the result.
pairs.explanation: QAOA or annealing proposes candidates while classical code constructs the objective, tunes parameters, and validates the result.

pairs.label: Improve a quantum workflow
pairs.detail: ML can also help calibrate devices, decode errors, or design circuits.
pairs.explanation: ML can also help calibrate devices, decode errors, or design circuits. This is machine learning for quantum systems, a related but distinct direction.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. Treat phrases such as "quantum parallelism" and "exponential speedup" as claims with assumptions, not as product capabilities.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Learn from classical data: Quantum kernels and variational classifiers can process encoded vectors. Learn from quantum data: A circuit can classify or characterize states produced by a quantum process. Optimize a classical objective: QAOA or annealing proposes candidates while classical code constructs the objective, tunes parameters, and validates the result. Improve a quantum workflow: ML can also help calibrate devices, decode errors, or design circuits.

pairs.label: Quantum kernel method
pairs.detail: Estimate pairwise similarities with a quantum feature map, then train a classical kernel model.
pairs.explanation: Estimate pairwise similarities with a quantum feature map, then train a classical kernel model. Kernel-matrix size, state preparation, and shots are central costs.

pairs.label: Variational quantum model
pairs.detail: Optimize circuit parameters from measured losses.
pairs.explanation: Optimize circuit parameters from measured losses. Expressivity must be balanced against depth, trainability, and device noise.

pairs.label: Quantum linear-algebra method
pairs.detail: Some algorithms offer strong asymptotic results under efficient data access, condition-number, precision, and output assumptions.
pairs.explanation: Some algorithms offer strong asymptotic results under efficient data access, condition-number, precision, and output assumptions. Audit each assumption explicitly.

pairs.label: Quantum optimization method
pairs.detail: Use QAOA, annealing, or another quantum routine to sample candidate solutions.
pairs.explanation: Use QAOA, annealing, or another quantum routine to sample candidate solutions. Compare quality and total resource cost with competitive classical solvers.

variants.title: Make the decision
variants.context: Quantum machine learning (QML) studies whether quantum information processing can improve a machine learning task. A quantum circuit may encode an input, transform a quantum state, and produce measurements that a classical program turns into a prediction, loss, kernel value, or optimization update.
variants.prompt: Which statement is the core engineering test for a useful QML advantage?
options: It survives input preparation and measurement costs while beating a strong classical baseline at matched quality
The circuit uses superposition
The simulator reports a shorter circuit depth
The model contains more qubits than features
variants.explanation: A useful claim is end to end. It includes data access, execution, measurement, output, quality, and a competitive comparator.
